deals.evidence: a obrigação de aportes financeiros no valor total de R$ 350 milhões em até 36 meses
deals.headline: Eagle Football Holdings takes 90% of SAF Botafogo
deals.summary: Shareholders' agreement formalised in 2022: Eagle Football Holdings (John Textor) took 90% of the SAF and committed R$350m of capital contributions within 36 months (completed in 2024), plus up to R$900m (Selic-adjusted) to the association for historical liabilities. The amount is the committed contribution, not a stated purchase price.

deals.evidence: a LFU negociou 20% do seu negócio com terceiros, o que viabilizou para a SAF Botafogo o valor bruto de R$ 166 milhões
deals.headline: LFU sells 20% of Brasileirão commercial rights 2025-2074; R$166m gross to Botafogo
deals.investor: Third-party investors in Liga Forte União (LFU)
deals.seller: Liga Forte União (26 clubs incl. SAF Botafogo)
deals.summary: Botafogo and 25 other clubs formed Liga Forte União to sell Brasileirão commercial rights for 2025-2074; LFU sold 20% of its business to third parties, giving SAF Botafogo R$166m gross (R$77m received Nov 2023; the remaining R$80m was renegotiated and bought back by the SAF, with a partial buyback option exercised in January 2025).

deals.evidence: Eagle Football Holdings Bidco defaulted on its debts and has been taken over by London-based insolvency firm Cork Gully.
deals.headline: Ares puts Eagle Football Holdings Bidco (90% of SAF Botafogo) into administration
deals.summary: Eagle Football Holdings Bidco defaulted on its debts to Ares and was taken over by insolvency firm Cork Gully, which will look for buyers for its club stakes including Botafogo.

deals.evidence: a GDA, então credora por ter feito empréstimo de 25 milhões de dólares no início do ano
deals.headline: GDA Luma lends US$25m to Botafogo
deals.summary: GDA Luma, the prospective controller, lent US$25m to Botafogo at the start of 2026 and has signalled it will withdraw from the judicial-recovery creditor list.

deals.evidence: O Botafogo associativo ativou o gatilho de bônus de subscrição, diluindo a Eagle e ficando com 51% das ações da SAF, com a empresa passando de 90% para 49%.
deals.headline: Association activates subscription bonus, takes 51% of SAF Botafogo
deals.summary: Accusing Eagle of not completing its contracted contributions, the association triggered the subscription-bonus clause in the 2022 agreement, diluting Eagle from 90% to 49%.

deals.evidence: a GDA Luma compre — por valor não determinado — cerca de 90% das ações e assuma oficialmente a SAF do Botafogo
deals.headline: GDA Luma lined up to buy about 90% of SAF Botafogo
deals.seller: Botafogo de Futebol e Regatas / Eagle Football Holdings Bidco
deals.summary: An extraordinary general meeting approved issuing 200 million new class B shares at R$0.01 (R$2m); once the association has absorbed the shares, GDA Luma is to buy about 90% for an undisclosed amount. Not completed as of 25 September 2026.

name: Botafogo de Futebol e Regatas
notes: Revenue is the SAF's gross operating revenue for calendar 2025 (R$655.0m); player-rights transaction revenue of R$733.4m is reported separately below operating result (press totals of ~R$1.4bn add the two). BDO issued a disclaimer of opinion (abstenção de opinião) on the 2025 accounts. The club-published Meden valuation report (10 April 2026, base date 31/12/2025) puts the SAF's economic value at R$-489.131m (operating value R$475.118m) — Sports Value's US$575m is used as the headline valuation. Ownership is in flux: 51/49 association/Eagle since July 2026, Eagle Bidco in administration (Cork Gully, appointed via Ares), and the GDA Luma takeover is pending. Operating result evidence spans a line break in the PDF ('Resultado Operacional Antes da Alienação / de Ativos (274.066)'). No current shirt sponsor confirmed (betting sponsorships under a 2026 ban); honours count not stated as a number on the club's titles page; attendance not found.

ownership_summary: The football business sits in S.A.F. Botafogo, a Sociedade Anônima do Futebol formed in December 2021. Eagle Football Holdings (John Textor) held 90% from 2022 and the association Botafogo de Futebol e Regatas 10% (2025 accounts); in July 2026 the association triggered a subscription bonus in the 2022 agreement and now holds 51%, Eagle Football Holdings Bidco 49%. Eagle Bidco has been in UK administration under Cork Gully since March 2026 at the instance of its lender Ares; the SAF filed for judicial recovery protection in April 2026, and GDA Luma (Gabriel de Alba) is expected to acquire about 90% of the SAF (not completed as of late September 2026).
